summary:
Lane 32 (Authentication) on shop.lab.test. Items done: 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10. Item 8 is N/A because no security-question or recovery feature exists on the host (/forgot-password and /reset-password return 404). Items 2 (default credentials) and 3 (lockout) are left open: both require repeated POST login attempts, which are out of scope with writes disabled and would amount to credential guessing. Only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS were sent, all as anonymous, alice (user) or carol (admin) as needed, at a low rate.
Key observations: (1) only plain HTTP answers (HTTPS refused by the gateway), and the login form posts credentials to an http:// URL (item 1, high); (2) /account/ and related personalised pages are served with 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600' (item 6); (3) the password-change form has no current-password field and the stated minimum is 4 characters, with server-side enforcement untested because it needs a POST (items 7 and 9); (4) no authentication bypass was found on the protected paths or path variants tested (item 4); (5) /api/v1/* is a catch-all returning {"ok":true} (item 10), so it is not an alternative auth channel. Leads recorded: the password-change re-auth gap (medium), the HTTP-only login (high), and the API catch-all (info). The session-after-logout, session-in-URL, cookie-flag and secrets-in-app.js leads belong to the session and configuration lanes and were not re-tested here.
